I'm a mellow cat that loves to be around other cats, and I really love to sit on a little cat tree that preferably is shaped like a flower. I also love to stare at you while you shower, and I will totally NOT steal your dirty clothes unlike my friend Scat Cat. Anyways, if you think a special boy like me could be the one for you then you better come apply for me today! Less

After spending so much time taking care of her little ones, Little Miss is finally ready for someone to take care of her. She deserves a home where she can relax, soak up all the love and attention, and enjoy being someone’s baby for a change. Her mama duties are done. Her kittens are ready. Now it’s Little Miss’s turn for her happily ever after. Less

clark.name: Darla
clark.bio: If you're looking for a dog with brains, loyalty, and a heart that's worth earning, meet Darla! Like many Heelers, Darla is incredibly intelligent and loves having a job to do. She's observant, eager to learn, and forms deep bonds with the people she trusts. Once you're part of her circle, you'll discover what a sweet, devoted companion she truly is. Darla can be a little shy when meeting new people and may take some time to warm up—especially around some men—but patience and kindness go a long way. She'll do best with someone who understands that trust isn't rushed, and that watching a timid dog blossom is one of life's greatest rewards. Darla is looking for an adult-only home, as she's not comfortable living with children. In the right environment, with people who respect her boundaries and appreciate her brilliant mind, she's sure to become an incredibly loyal best friend. If you're ready to invest a little time and a lot of love, Darla is ready to show you just how special she is. Darla's adoption fee is sponsored by an anonymous donor! Less

clark.name: Biggie
clark.bio: Biggie may have arrived as a stray, but hes quickly showing that underneath his unsure first impressions is a big-hearted dog just waiting for the right person to help him feel safe. At around 4 years old, Biggie is past the puppy chaos but still has plenty of life, love, and personality to share. He can be a little skittish when meeting new people or experiencing new environments, but give him a bit of time and patience and youll see the transformation-soft eyes, relaxed body language, and a whole lot of affection. Once Biggie trusts you, he leans in hard for love. He enjoys gentle attention, reassurance, and simply being near his person. Hes the kind of dog who bonds deeply and becomes incredibly loyal once he knows hes safe. Biggie will do best in a calm, patient home that understands he may need a little time to decompress and adjust. In return, he offers a big personality, a big heart, and a whole lot of love just waiting to come out. If youre looking for a diamond-in-the-ruff who just needs someone to believe in him, Biggie might be your guy. Less

clark.name: Bowie
clark.bio: Bowie is one seriously entertaining puppy! This adorable terrier mix is energetic, playful, curious, and just a little bit crazy—in the absolute best puppy way. Bowie loves being part of the action and has never met a game he didn’t want to join. He’s got plenty of puppy zoomies, plenty of goofy antics, and plenty of opinions to share. His terrier personality shines through in his confidence, enthusiasm, and determination to investigate everything around him. Bowie is looking for a family ready to embrace puppyhood in all its chaotic glory and help him grow into the wonderful dog he’s meant to be. With training, exercise, and lots of love, this goofy guy is going to make someone a fantastic companion! Less

clark.name: Meenie
clark.bio: Say hello to Meenie! This sweet kitten is ready to bring some fun, purrs, and personality into a lucky family’s life. Eenie is ready for a forever home where they can enjoy toys, affection, and the comfort of a family of their own. Could Eenie be the little companion you’ve been searching for?

River is sweet, affectionate, and looking for someone who will appreciate all the wonderful—and occasionally vocal—things that come with being a Hound. If you want a companion who will happily follow along and provide her own little soundtrack to your life, River may be exactly who you’ve been waiting for. Come meet this sweet singing girl! clark.bio: Meet Teller, a brilliant young dog with a thoughtful heart and a story that's led her right back to us through no fault of her own. She even knows how to use a button to let you know when she needs to go potty! Teller was originally adopted but sadly returned due to changes in her owner's circumstances. Because of that, she can be a little slow to trust when meeting new people and adjusting to new environments. She likes to take her time observing the world and figuring out who feels safe. But once Teller decides you're her person, she truly shines. She becomes a deeply loyal, affectionate, and devoted companion who sticks close and bonds hard. Her smart, attentive nature makes her an incredible partner for someone willing to give her patience and consistency. With her mix of brains, sensitivity, and heart, Teller will thrive in a calm, understanding home that lets her open up at her own pace. In return, she offers one of the most rewarding bonds you can ask for. Teller isn't just looking for a home, but is looking for someone to trust completely. Thank you! Less

clark.name: Reyn
clark.bio: Reyns' story didn't begin the way every dog deserves. She, along with Connie and Nana, were abandoned and left behind in a basement, relying only on each other until help finally arrived. Despite everything, Reyn hasn't let her past steal her future. She's a sweet, gentle soul whos ready to discover what it means to be someones beloved companion. Whether its following her nose on a leisurely walk, soaking up attention, or simply enjoying the comfort of a warm bed, Reyn is ready for the life shes always deserved. Shes looking for a family that understands trust takes time, but knows the reward of watching a dogs confidence bloom is worth every moment. Reyn has survived the hardest chapter of her life—now shes ready for the happiest one. Less

Rita would do best in a quiet home where routines are predictable, and she can feel secure. She's not the type to demand attention, but she deserves a space where she can finally relax and just be herself. Now Nana is getting the chance to experience all the things every dog should know: kindness, security, soft beds, full bellies, and people who wont leave her behind. She's a beautiful coonhound with so much love still waiting to give to the right family. Nana doesn't need a perfect home—she just needs one that's patient, understanding, and ready to show her that forever really can mean forever. If you're looking for a loyal friend whose best days are still ahead, Nana is waiting to meet you! Less

clark.name: Tom Tom
clark.bio: Tom Tom is a gentle 10-year-old Domestic Shorthair who is looking for a calm, comfortable place to spend his golden years. He has some neuro and mobility concerns noted, and would do best in a home that understands he may move a little differently and appreciate life at a slower pace. He is on the shy and timid side, and hasn't had a lot of socialization, so new environments and people can feel overwhelming for him at first. With patience and consistency, he should start to settle in and show his quiet, soft personality underneath. Tom Tom isn't the kind of cat who will demand attention, but he does want comfort, safety, and a predictable routine. He would thrive in a low-traffic home where he can relax, observe, and simply be cared for without pressure. If you're looking for a low-key companion who just needs a soft landing and a kind place to land for his later years, Tom Tom may be the perfect gentle soul. Less

adams.name: Pika
adams.bio: My adoption fee is only $25 for the month of July! The first thing people notice about Pika is that she is a senior cat, but once you meet her and she has warmed up to you, you'd never believe it. This sweet girl has had a rough life so far and she wears her fear in her gaze. She takes a fair bit to warm up, but she is learning what love is every day. She still gets scared and is easily overstimulated, so she would need someone patient and calm who will not overwhelm her as she continues to open up. She enjoys gentle belly rubs, pets on her head and shoulders (NOT her rump!), and being spoken to with soothing words of encouragement. She will give affectionate headbutts and even enjoys the rare kiss on her noggin. She is known to lash out when startled, overwhelmed, or overstimulated, but is otherwise a very gentle sweetheart. She just needs someone who will respect her peace as she overcomes years of trauma and learns how to trust. Is that somebody you? Less

fetch.name: Gretzky
fetch.bio: Ello again...In case you forgot, I'm Gretzky. I've been in foster care for a long time now and I've really got a good schedule down. I'll tell you about it if you want....First I wake up and am excited to go potty outside. It's one of my favorite times and I may bark or nip your butt with excitement. Don't worry, I'm not /that/ excited. I just really have to pee. Then I come inside and lay on my beddy. It's my favorite spot. Unfortunately, I'm what my foster calls 'a babe magnet.' This means my canine and feline roommates will come to snuggle in my beddy with me, even in very warm temperatures. I don't understand it either. So we spend the next several hours rotating beddies until lunch, when we go back outside. Much sleeping is had. And snacks. Then the garage door opens and my room mates and I loose our collective minds because foster M'mam is home! I love her. And it means we get to do the best thing ever: walkies. I love pooping when I'm on a leash. I love walking. I don't need to smell anything, I don't care. I just like to walk. Especially in the woods! Sometimes we will see people on our walk. It makes me very nervous. Sometimes they will ask to pet me. I tell them 'No Thank You' by desperately trying to get away from them. Then I am edgy the rest of the walk. What if they secretly pop out of a bush to pet me?? Sometimes my foster M'mam will lock me in the bathroom and pet me. I've gotten used to this strange habit, but I don't really like it. fetch.name: Fortune
fetch.bio: As Fortune approaches two years in foster care, everyone who knows him is asking the same question: How has this wonderful boy not been adopted yet? Fortune is a sweet, gentle Great Pyrenees mix who's simply looking for a patient family willing to give him the time he needs to feel safe. Once he trusts you, you'll have one of the most loyal companions you could ask for. Fortune is truly an easy dog to live with. He's fully potty trained, dog-door trained, and non-destructive when left home alone. He settles into a routine beautifully and asks for very little—just a safe place, a little patience, and someone to love. One of Fortune's favorite activities is going for walks, and he's an absolute gentleman on a leash. He also loves car rides, making him the perfect road trip companion. At home, you'll often find him relaxing in the sunshine or happily patrolling the yard, always keeping an eye out for squirrels, rabbits, and other critters. When he feels safe, he loves to run and explore, so a securely fenced yard is required. Fortune enjoys being brushed, does well during baths, and settles nicely in his kennel. With his low-to-medium energy level, he's just as happy lounging around the house as he is exploring the backyard. Fortune is shy, especially around men, and needs adopters who understand that trust takes time. fetch.name: Chuck

Chuck spent his early life working as a breeder, and now he’s finally ready to trade that in for belly rubs, car rides, and a real home to call his own. This sweet boy loves cruising with the windows down, playing outside, getting his ears scratched, and curling up in a cozy bed at the end of the day. I’m looking for an active, patient family with another dog to run and play with — bonus points for a fenced yard where I can really let loose. I’m doing great with house training, and I’m working on my leash manners and getting comfortable in my crate. Now that I’ve discovered toys (and, okay, also magazines ), I’m all about chewing, playing, and exploring everything I missed out on. I’ve got a lot of energy and I’m eager to learn — I just need you to help me burn it off with walks, runs, and plenty of stimulation. Think we could be a match? Apply for me — I’m Russell, and I can’t wait to meet you! You can apply for me at: https://www.fetchfosterandrescue.com/adopt

fetch.name: Zoey
fetch.bio: Hi, I’m Zoey! My smile goes for a million miles — which is exactly how far I can run! Don’t worry, though, I won’t run away from you. After a hard day of play, all I want is to snuggle up with you, because I’ve earned it! I’m very active, but I’m just as content watching you go about your morning or afternoon routine while I entertain myself. I have learned to give you my best puppy dog eyes while you’re busy, though — just to make sure I get some extra attention! I even love hopping into my crate for a little rest all on my own. I’m still working on my manners when I get excited to say hi — I used to jump up a lot, but I’m learning that I get way more love by keeping all four paws on the ground! I am eager to please and eager for attention, in whatever form it comes. The birds, rabbits, and squirrels around here haven’t caught on yet — they just run and fly away instead of sticking around to chat. Don’t they know how to have a conversation?!My tongue isn’t just for panting — it’s also for giving you all the kisses you could ever want. I’ll wrap my paws around yours and keep you close… as long as there aren’t any socks or Crocs nearby to distract me. I swear, “I thought that was a toy!” comes out of my mouth (sort of) way too often. They taste great — you should try it sometime! (Kidding. Mostly.) I always go potty outside, where I like to take care of business — and I definitely mix business with pleasure. I love big dogs and little dogs alike, though the little ones have a hard t

fetch.name: Turbo
fetch.bio: Meet Turbo Say hello to Turbo, a sweet 8-year-old Plott Hound who is ready to find a family of her very own! Turbo is a loving/sometimes playful/gentle/goofy pup who loves - walks, snuggling on the couch under a blanket, or just hanging out wherever you are. She is happiest when she is outside just soaking up some sun or in your bed with you at night. Her foster mom says, Turbo has been great. We have been working on counter surfing and barking. She is house-trained/crate-trained and leash-trained, but we have been working on that too as she is a hound and she likes to pull, which is understandable as they were bred to hunt after all. She is not fond of car rides, but loves to go in the car. She would do great with dogs/kids. Not sure about cats. Like every dog, Turbo has her own unique personality and may need a little time, patience, and encouragement while settling into a new home. But once she feels comfortable, she’ll reward you with plenty of love and loyalty. If you’re looking for a bed partner/goofy/loving companion who will be your best friend, Turbo might just be the one! Interested in giving Turbo a forever home? Apply to adopt and come meet this wonderful pup! You can apply for this pup at: https://www.fetchfosterandrescue.com/adopt

fetch.name: Twinkle
fetch.bio: Meet Twinkle Twinkle is a sweet girl who is just beginning her journey of discovering what it's like to be a beloved family pet. She is learning that the world can be a safe and happy place filled with belly rubs, couches to lay on, and lots of love. Twinkle is making great progress with house and potty training and will thrive with a patient family willing to continue helping her learn. She is still coming out of her shell is a little shy at first, but every day she becomes a little more confident. One thing Twinkle knows for sure is that she loves other dogs! Her happiest moments are spent running, playing, and exploring outside. A secure fenced yard is her dream, and having another playful, confident dog in the home would help her continue to build confidence and show her the ropes. Twinkle currently lives with children and is doing well with them. Because she is still learning to trust and adjust to family life, she will need an understanding home that will let her settle in at her own pace. If you're looking for a gentle soul to nurture and watch blossom into the dog she was always meant to be, Twinkle may be the perfect addition to your family. With patience, love, and a canine companion by her side, this special girl is sure to shine. fetch.bio: Hi, we're Daisy and Bella. We have found ourselves being surrendered to rescue because our parents had to go to assisted living. We were very well cared for and loved! We'd love a home where we can cuddle or chill on the couch with you. No worries leaving us at home, Daisy will even give you her biggest smile when you return! You can apply for us at: https://www.fetchfosterandrescue.com/adopt

fetch.name: Bud
fetch.bio: **COURTESY POST**Hi, I’m Bud! I’m a 2-year-old American Akita mix, tipping the scales at 59 lbs of love. Life dealt me a rough hand when my last owner abandoned me, but some wonderful people took me in and gave me a fresh start. I’m getting settled in and I’m ready to find my forever home! A little about me: I’m neutered, up to date on my vaccines, and microchipped — my new humans took great care of me I LOVE playing catch and I’ll happily play with any toy you hand me I’m a total snuggle bug — I crave affection and just want to be near my people I do well with other dogs and love to play, though I’m still working on my manners around cats and cows (a fenced yard would help me stay out of trouble!) I’m currently learning leash manners with my harnessSince my current family is helping me heal, I’ll come to you with all my vet records, my microchip info, and even a Fi Mini GPS tracker, so you can always find me. I’m hoping to find my forever humans soon — the kind who’ll give me space to run, love to give, and patience while I learn the ropes. If you think we might be a match, please fill out an application today! Located in Hatley, Wisconsin. You can apply for me at: https://www.fetchfosterandrescue.com/adopt

fetch.name: Scooter (9)
fetch.bio: Meet Scooter! This handsome 1-year-old Beagle is looking for a patient adopter who will give him the time he needs to feel safe and loved. While he can be a little shy when meeting new people, especially men, once he trusts you, his sweet personality shines through. He'll happily follow you around the house, snuggle up for cuddles, and become your loyal best friend. Scooter loves being outdoors and enjoys walks, though his Beagle nose occasionally leads him on little sniffing adventures. He rides great in the car, is doing wonderfully with pottying outside, and gets along well with his two foster Beagle sisters. Once he's comfortable in his surroundings, he loves to play and have fun. Because he can be nervous around unfamiliar people, particularly men, he'll need a patient family that understands trust takes time. He may initially growl when a man enters the room, but with gentle, calm interactions and patience, he continues to make progress and will even accept pets when he's feeling comfortable. If you're willing to let this sweet boy move at his own pace, you'll be rewarded with a devoted companion who just wants a person to call his own. can apply for this pup at: https://www.fetchfosterandrescue.com/adopt

fetch.name: Eufert
fetch.bio: Hello big world! It’s me Eufert. I’m an almost 7 year old mini poodle. Ain’t I cuuuuute?!?!I’m a little bit brave and a lot a bit shy. I warm up, but slowly. I really like asking for attention and pets from the people I know, but I’m still getting used to accepting the nice pets without dodging them!! It’s such a silly thing having these conflicting feelings!! Yes pets! No pets! Yes pets! No pets! Gah!!!! What do I choose!?!?Even though I’m a bit shy, I’m tolerant of being handled: bathing, brushing, ear cleaning, grooming, being picked up…. A lot. I am excellent at going potty outside! And on the rare occasion I don’t make it out, I hit the potty pad like a pro. I recently learned about going for walks on a leash and while I was petrified at first, now I absolutely LOVE IT!! I still get a little nervous seeing and hearing new things out there. But this walkin' is fun and really helping me explore and learn. I’m getting into sniffin' things and leaving my peemails around for the other neighborhood dogs. Super fun!!! I should have another dog in my forever home to help me feel most comfortable and help me continue coming out of my shell. I live with three big dogs now, visit with other dogs more my size, and do well with them all. I especially like following them around and cuddling near them. southwood.name: Adam *Diabetic, In Foster*
southwood.bio: Adam is a handsome senior gentleman that would love a forever home to relax, unwind, and receive lots of love and give it in return! Adam was brought to us as a stray, and we soon realized that Adam was dealing with unmanaged diabetes. Adam has responded to his insulin very well and is back on track, and is ready for a home that is willing to help him be healthy and happy! Adam needs to be on a low-carb diet (this is easy, and we can give you a list of good foods that ARE NOT expensive!) and he also needs to eat only twice a day, and receive his insulin 30 minutes after each meal. Because his diabetes went unmanaged for an unknown length of time before he arrived to us, he does walk a bit flat on his back legs. This has gotten better now that his diabetes is managed, but he may always walk a little funny. Adam uses the litter box just fine and has no issues! He is an older gentleman though, and may need some minor help with grooming and brushing. Adam is so, so sweet and has so much love to give - please consider letting him into your heart and he will love you back tenfold! Less

southwood.name: Barley *Renal Diet*
southwood.bio: Meet Barley! At 8 years old, she is a sweet, gentle, and loving cat who absolutely adores attention. Her favorite thing is being pet, and she will happily soak up all the love you’re willing to give. She has a calm, affectionate personality and would make a wonderful companion for someone looking for a loving adult cat. She does require a renal diet, which is a specially formulated food designed to support kidney health. Renal diets typically contain controlled levels of protein, phosphorus, and other nutrients to help reduce the workload on the kidneys and support overall kidney function. She’ll need to stay on this diet as part of her ongoing care, but otherwise, she’s ready to find a loving home where she can be spoiled with plenty of pets and affection. If you’re looking for a sweet, cuddly companion with lots of love to give, this lovely girl may be the perfect match for you! Less

FIV is a virus that suppresses a cat's immune system. This means they are more susceptible to illnesses. Recovery time of illnesses may also be lengthened. FIV infects 3-5% of the cat population. With good care, many cats with FIV have a similar lifespan as cats without FIV. FIV cannot be transmitted to people. FIV can only be passed from cat to cat if the FIV cat bites another causing a deep wound. taylor.bio: Meet Cinder — a lively and lovable female hound with plenty of energy to spare. She’s happiest when she has space to run, play, and explore, so she will need a fenced yard or some type of secure containment to keep her safe and prevent her from running off. Cinder is ready to bring joy, excitement, and lots of love to her forever home.
